preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 10**6 for n in ns_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length n is an integer between 2 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abc' for c in s) and len(s) == n for s, n in zip(s_list, ns_list))
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of characters 'a', 'b', 'c' and has length exactly n.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((res == -1 and not any_valid(s)) or (res == min_valid_len(s)) for res, s in zip(results, s_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if no valid substring exists, output is -1; otherwise, output is the length of the smallest valid substring.
